factor_factor..write: auth != null && root.child('games/factor/logins/' + $account + '/' + auth.uid).exists() && root.child('games/factor/titleNextV1/awards/' + $account + '/factor_factor/earned').val() === true && newData.exists()
factor_factor..validate: newData.hasChildren(['seen','at']) && newData.child('seen').val() === true && (data.exists() && newData.child('at').val() === data.child('at').val() || !data.exists() && newData.child('at').val() === now)
